question: The FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup was held at _____ venues in India from October 11 to 30, 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**three**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2022 was hosted by India from **October 11 to October 30, 2022**.
 
• The tournament matches were held at **three venues** across the country: Bhubaneswar (Kalinga Stadium), Goa (Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, Fatorda), and Navi Mumbai (DY Patil Stadium).
 
• This was the **seventh edition** of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup and the first time India hosted the tournament.
 
• A total of **16 teams** participated in the event, including India as the host nation.
 
• The tournament aims to provide a platform to showcase young female football talent globally, promoting women's football.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup:**

 
 
• It is an international football competition organized by FIFA for female players under the age of 17.
 
• The tournament began in 2008 and is held every two years.
 
• The 2022 edition marked the first time India hosted the tournament, underscoring its growing importance in global women's football.
 
 
 
• **Host Venues in India (2022):**
 
 
• **Kalinga Stadium, Bhubaneswar:** A prominent venue in Odisha known for hosting major sporting events.
 
• **Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, Fatorda:** Located in Goa, it is one of the best football stadiums in India.
 
• **DY Patil Stadium, Navi Mumbai:** A multi-purpose stadium that has hosted several international sports events.
 
 
 
• **Women's Football Development:**
 
 
• The tournament promotes the development of women's football globally by providing a platform for young players.
 
• FIFA and host nations also organize grassroots programs to encourage local participation in women's football.
 
 
 
• **India's Participation:**
 
 
• As the host nation, India automatically qualified for the tournament.
 
• This was a significant opportunity to showcase Indian women's football talent on a global stage.
